column1: # Received copies of letters 2-4 (Lee Family Papers, University of Virginia; 1966 microfilm ed. Hoffman and Molyneaux, roll 6,
# Internet Archive per_lee-family-papers_the-lee-family-papers_1742-1795_6). Read 14 Nov 2026 by an AI agent from the
# full-size images (two passes on doubtful marks); no person has checked it.
# id = decoding.tsv id. lb_group = group as written in the letter book (transcription.md). rc_group = group as written on the
# received copy. diff = how the two copies differ. interlined = what is written above (or beside) the group; "-" = nothing.
# layer: A = darker, ink-like marks of one to three letters (skeletons such as s-t-e, or initials); B = fainter, thinner
# full words, often with "?" (microfilm is black and white: ink and pencil cannot be told apart for certain).
# score: 1 same word; 2 same word, other inflection, or an abbreviation that only our word fits; 3 different word;
# 4 absent, illegible, or a partial mark too short to decide (note says "partial, consistent" when it fits ours).
